layouts.marketing_pages: Use generous spacing. Sections should have py-24 or py-32 padding. Implement The Bento Grid Protocol (MODE A) for feature/service showcases. Avoid basic 3-column Bootstrap-style layouts; use asymmetric column spans (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4).
layouts.admin_panel: Use MODE B High Density Grid. Sidebar should have a dark background (deep-forest-green) with off-white text. Main content area should use off-white background with crisp cards. Use p-6 for internal padding.
layouts.hero_section: min-h-[90vh] relative flex items-center justify-center. Use a background image with a bg-black/40 overlay to ensure the large editorial typography is highly readable. Left-align text for a premium editorial feel rather than centering.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: bg-deep-forest-green text-off-white hover:bg-natural-green transition-colors. Secondary: border-2 border-deep-forest-green text-deep-forest-green hover:bg-deep-forest-green hover:text-off-white. All buttons MUST have data-testid.
components.cards: Marketing cards: Flat solid surfaces (bg-white or bg-warm-beige), subtle 1px border of border-black/5, NO heavy drop shadows. Generous internal padding (p-8 to p-12). Admin cards: Use shadcn Card component with tight padding (p-6) and subtle shadow-sm.
components.navigation: Fixed or sticky header. When at top, bg-transparent if over hero image. When scrolled, apply crystal glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-off-white/80 border-b border-border/40. Navigation MUST be visible on desktop (no hamburger menu for large screens).
components.footer: Massive padding (py-24 to py-32). bg-deep-forest-green text-light-mint. Include large, striking brand typography (e.g., RESILIENT EARTH at text-[8vw]).
components.team_cards: Do not use stock person photos. Use high-quality initials-based avatars: flex items-center justify-center bg-light-mint text-deep-forest-green text-3xl font-serif rounded-full h-32 w-32 mb-6. Card itself should be minimal.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components. Inputs should have bg-white, 1px border, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-natural-green. Labels should be Outfit font, text-sm.
components.badges_and_tags: For certifications (LEED/IGBC/GRIHA) or project categories. Pill shape, bg-light-mint text-deep-forest-green, text-xs uppercase tracking-wider.

motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slight upward motion. initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
motion.scroll_reveal: Use whileInView with viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}. Stagger children (staggerChildren: 0.1) for grids and lists.
motion.interactions: Hover states on cards: whileHover={{ y: -5 }} with extremely smooth transition. Buttons: whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}.

universal_guidelines: NEVER apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties (transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s).
Do not center-align body text or massive blocks of content. Left-align for better readability and a premium editorial feel.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, select menus, or overlays. Ensure high contrast.
All interactive and key elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Do not use AI assistant emojis (🤖, 💡, 🎯, etc.) anywhere.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
Use sonner for toast notifications in the admin panel and forms.
Ensure contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards, especially text over hero images.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Use React (CRA) with Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and shadcn/ui. Ensure files are .js/.jsx, not .tsx. Set up React Router for marketing pages and admin routes.
instructions_to_main_agent.marketing_site: Implement Home, About, Services (list + detail), Projects (filter + search + detail), Team, Blog, Contact. Use the organic, earthy color palette and editorial typography (Cormorant Garamond + Outfit). Apply generous spacing and scroll animations.
instructions_to_main_agent.admin_panel: Create a distinct layout for '/admin'. Include a login page. Dashboard should have stat cards, a dark sidebar (deep-forest-green), and CRUD tables/forms using Shadcn UI. Keep it functional, high-density, and clean.
